component.name: Packlift
component.summary: Install packages with your system, Toolbox or Wine
Instale pacotes pelo sistema, Toolbox ou Wine
Instala paquetes con el sistema, Toolbx o Wine
Устанавливайте пакеты через систему, Toolbx или Wine
通过系统、Toolbx 或 Wine 安装软件包

description.p: Open a downloaded package, review its origin and installation method, and follow progress in one window. Packlift adds installed desktop programs to the system menu and lets you remove them from the application.
Packlift can run commands on the host to use your package manager, Toolbox and Wine. Toolbox and Wine programs can access your home directory.
Abra um pacote baixado, revise a origem e o método de instalação e acompanhe o progresso na mesma janela. O Packlift adiciona programas ao menu do sistema e permite desinstalá-los pelo aplicativo.
O Packlift pode executar comandos no host para usar o gerenciador de pacotes, o Toolbox e o Wine. Programas instalados em Toolbox ou Wine podem acessar sua pasta pessoal.
Update the application ID used by the Flatpak, desktop launcher and file associations.
Install supported Linux packages, manage Windows programs and games, and run compatible AppImages and TAR archives in the Flatpak sandbox.
